title: Object Playground
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website screenshot for Storm Selvig portfolio, concept titled "Object Playground".
Primary request: crisp flat front-facing desktop website screenshot, 16:10-ish landscape, preferably 1536x1024. This is an experimental digital playground with 3D and hands-on mini experiences, visualized as a buildable WebGL interface.
Scene/backdrop: spacious powder-blue entire viewport. Dominant playable 3D floor fills lower two-thirds, not a bounded hero rectangle; pale blue orthographic ground with soft natural shadows.
Composition/framing: oversized dark ultramarine geometric grotesk words "STORM SELVIG" across upper-left/middle, deliberately interrupted by tangible 3D interactive objects. Strong asymmetry with careful spacing and spatial typography. A minimal navigation row along the top: "Storm Selvig" on left; "Playground", "About", "Contact" on right. Main headline "Ideas you can play with." and small introduction "Software, hardware, and a little curiosity."
Subjects: three large meticulously modeled objects, illustrative concepts rather than factual replicas. An orange stylized electronic desk clock with LCD reading "12:48" and visible exposed dark green circuit board. A compact abstract blue-and-yellow underwater ROV frame with four cylindrical thrusters. A polished blue camera lens looking at a tiny orange road sign. Include precise text labels "Smart Clock", "UiASub RTOS", "AI Dashcam" close to their respective objects.
Interaction: central hover popover near clock, immaculate flat pale card, says "Smart Clock" then "Turn it over. See what makes it tick." with a small arrow affordance; communicate that underside is accessible using an orbit interaction. A few playful orange sphere and cobalt spring physics objects add life, no dense confetti.
Footer controls: bottom left subtle hint "Drag to explore · Select an object to play". Bottom right "01 / 03" exhibit navigation and "View all projects". Small subtle bottom caption "Illustrative project models".
Style: impeccable premium experimental portfolio, refined full viewport composition, visually stunning and completely polished, realistic legible interactive controls. Physically plausible detailed 3D shapes with premium materials and soft natural lighting. Main image palette powder blue, dark ultramarine, vivid orange, deep circuit-board green, small yellow accents.
Constraints: must look like a functional website, not a poster. Preserve core text legibility and exact text. No generic card grid, no resume columns, no fake awards or metrics, no gradients, no glowing neon, no floating decorative browser windows, no outer browser/device mockup.
feedback: User rejected the artificial taglines, colour palettes, and linear presentation. Wants 3D spatial navigation and nonlinear exploration rather than projects as 3D props.
